attack.name: Full Discharge

pattern.burstDesc: 600+ volts through the water. Everything wet in radius 2 convulses and drops what it's holding.

attack.telegraph: The water goes glass-still. A faint crackling, and the hairs on your arms lift. The eel's back arches — it is about to empty itself.

attacks.name: Full Discharge

pattern.burstDesc: 600+ volts through the water. Everything wet in radius 2 convulses.

attacks.telegraph: The water goes glass-still. A faint crackling, and the hairs on your arms lift.
The crackling fades. It slides backward into the black water, done spending itself — for now.

codexStages.observed: Electric eel. The System measured 860 volts and filed it under 'portable weather.' It hunts in the shallows, stunning fish — and anything else standing in the water.
codexStages.slain: Moves: Full Discharge (electric burst, radius 2 in water, telegraphed by crackling), Slip Away (below 30% it withdraws). The shock cannot cross dry ground. Fight it from the bank, never from the creek. Meat: long, boneless, excellent roasted.
codexStages.unknown: The creek went still, and your arm-hairs stood up.

counter.hint: Its shock travels through water, not air. It crackles before it fires — that sound is your whole warning.
counter.reveal: When the crackling starts, step onto dry ground — the discharge cannot reach you there. On land it is just a long blind fish: slow, harmless, dinner. Never fight it standing in the creek.

curious: It drifts closer, ripples spreading from its snout. Testing the water — literally.
fearful: It thrashes toward deep water, crackling in panic. It wants depth between you and it.
warn: The water stills. A faint crackling rises — the hairs on your arms lift. This is the warning.

edible.note: Long muscle, barely a bone in it. Roast it well — and make sure it's actually dead first. It can twitch a shock out for a while after.

encounter.comment: Living Wire: coil->crackle->discharge. Burst is water-only (radius 2); dry ground is immunity. Withdraws below 30% hp.
encounter.knownCue: Crackling water means get out. Dry ground is a wall it cannot cross.
encounter.knownTactics: Never fight it in the water. Bait the discharge, step ashore, strike while it recovers.

loot.note: Alien loot: low chance, tier scales with monster strength (Steve 2026-10-05).

name: The Living Wire
unknown: the creek went still, and your arm-hairs stood up
vibe: a living battery — patient, coiled, humming
weaknesses: the discharge cannot cross dry ground — fight from the bank
it must surface to breathe — watch for the roll, strike then

attack.name: Death Coil

pattern.ambushDesc: Grapples and constricts. Damage each turn until the coil is broken — strike the head.

attack.telegraph: The water bulges — a ripple with intent. Then the coils are around you, and each breath you let out is a breath you don't get back.

attacks.name: Death Coil

pattern.ambushDesc: Grapples and constricts. Damage each turn until broken.

attacks.telegraph: The water bulges — a ripple with intent.
It loosens, reluctantly, and pours itself back into the water. It will remember this pool.

codexStages.observed: Green anaconda. Twenty-plus feet of constrictor that hunts like the river itself — patient, submerged, inevitable. The System admires the efficiency and is taking notes.
codexStages.slain: Moves: Death Coil (ambush grapple from water, constricts each turn), Withdraw (below 25% it releases). It kills by wrapping, not biting. When the coils start, strike the head and eyes — it releases to protect them. Never let it get a second wrap. Meat: a feast. The hide is legendary.
codexStages.unknown: Something displaced a LOT of water, and it wasn't a log.

counter.hint: It kills by wrapping, not biting. It hates having its head touched — the head is the whole animal's pride.
counter.reveal: When the coils start to wrap, don't pull away — strike the head and eyes. It will release to protect them. On land it is slow and heavy; it needs the water to be the Empress. Never let it get a second wrap.
counter.trick: Strike the head as it coils

curious: A ripple crosses the pool toward you, slow and deliberate. Something is measuring you.
fearful: It uncoils in a rush and pours itself into deep water. Even the Empress knows fire.
warn: The water bulges. A ripple with intent — and then the coils move. This is the warning.

edible.note: A LOT of snake. Tough, rich, faintly fishy — and it feeds the whole village for days. The fat renders beautifully.

encounter.comment: Anaconda Empress: lurk->bulge->coil. Ambush grapple from water tiles; head strikes break the coil. Slow on land.
encounter.knownCue: A bulging ripple with intent — don't be in the water when it arrives.
encounter.knownTactics: Strike the head during the coil windup. Fight it on land if you must fight it at all.

loot.note: Alien loot: low chance, tier scales with monster strength (Steve 2026-10-05).

name: The Anaconda Empress
unknown: something displaced a LOT of water, and it wasn't a log
vibe: twenty feet of patience — she has been here longer than the river
weaknesses: striking the head breaks the coil — the head is sacred to it
slow and heavy on land — it needs the water to be dangerous
